name: Docker tools
author: Nova
description: Quick looks at Docker: disk use, the containers using the most memory, and recent restarts.

commands.name: Docker disk use
commands.description: Images, containers, volumes and build cache

commands.name: Recent restarts
commands.description: Containers that restarted, and how often
commands.command: docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | while read n; do c=$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$n"); [ "$c" != 0 ] && echo "$n: $c"; done; echo done
